items.text:
Didn't realize spaceport docking fees rack up based on time spent in dock, had my guy repairing my ship while I was off getting something to eat, docking fees ended up being 13000 dollars (i had 43 after paying my ships mortgage) so I lost the run.

Flying your way through space to derelict ships to loot, salvage and scavenge is an incredibly fun gameplay loop though, at least in theory. The game still needs some polish but for an early access game it really is quite nice.

There's definitely a learning curve. If you don't mind getting used to clunky mechanics and doing multiple runs to learn how to do things then definitely give it a try.
items.text_zh:
没意识到太空港的停靠费会根据停靠时间累积，我让我的家伙在修我的船，而我自己跑去弄点吃的，停靠费最后变成了13000美元（付完我的船贷后我只有43块），所以我这局就废了。

不过，穿越太空飞向废弃飞船去掠夺、打捞和搜刮，是一个极其有趣的玩法循环，至少理论上是这样。游戏还需要一些打磨，但作为一款抢先体验游戏，它真的相当不错。

肯定是有学习曲线的。如果你不介意去适应笨拙的机制，并且多跑几局来学会怎么做事情，那绝对值得一试。

observations.description: 游戏机制笨拙，需要时间适应。
observations.evidence: If you don't mind getting used to clunky mechanics
observations.evidence_zh: 如果你不介意习惯笨拙的机制

items.text:
This game need more content
It have Super interesting concept

Have met the bugs yet but lots of people mention its buggy i assume thats true

Only doing scavaging may becoming repetetive, they should add more intetesting event or make the salvaging interesting

Idk if i can suggest this game to common casual player but i can suggest it you guys that love to found hidden gem.

Ill keep the game to support the dev and ill be back playing this game in couple months after more updates.

Update: I've found some bugs while playing for longer time e.g. Permanent Vomit Debuff, Barter Zone made you unable to trade with Shop as it said you don't have enough money, thats all ive found

This game is not done dev should focus on more game mechanic as currently it's very lacking rather than polishing, there is framedrop when opening door

Still lacking game mechanic for what this game planning to be but really interesting concept and i cant wait to play much much more when they implement more game mechanic and content.
items.text_zh:
这款游戏需要更多内容
它的概念超级有趣

还没遇到漏洞，但很多人提到它漏洞多，我猜那是真的

只做打捞可能会变得重复，他们应该添加更多有趣的事件，或者让打捞变得有趣

我不知道自己能不能向普通休闲玩家推荐这款游戏，但我可以推荐给你们这些喜欢发掘隐藏佳作的人。

我会留着这款游戏以支持开发者，几个月后等更多更新出来，我会回来玩这款游戏。

更新：玩得更久后我发现了一些漏洞，例如永久呕吐减益、交易区让你无法与商店交易，因为它说你的钱不够，这就是我发现的全部

这款游戏还没做完，开发者应该专注于更多游戏机制，因为目前非常匮乏，而不是打磨，开门时还会掉帧

对于这款游戏计划成为的样子来说，仍然缺少游戏机制，但概念真的很有趣，我等不及在他们实现更多游戏机制和内容后玩得多得多。

observations.evidence: This game is not done dev should focus on more game mechanic as currently it's very lacking
